def union_elements(tup1: tuple, tup2: tuple) -> tuple:
    """Return the sorted union of two tuples."""
    # Use set to get unique elements automatically
    combined = set(tup1) | set(tup2)
    return tuple(sorted(combined))


# Example usage and assertion
assert union_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) == (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10)

print(union_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)))
# Output: (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10)
